title: `torch.quantized_max_pool1d`: Segfault

labels.name: module: crash
labels.description: Problem manifests as a hard crash, as opposed to a RuntimeError

body:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

`torch.quantized_max_pool1d` causes segfault with specific input.

Test code:
```python
import torch

base = torch.randn(1)
temp_tensor = torch.quantize_per_tensor(base, 0.1, 10, torch.quint2x4)
torch.quantized_max_pool1d(temp_tensor, [], [0,0], [0,0], [0,0,1], True)
```
